auditoria.erro: serve: page documents Whoosh's tokenizers, stemming and LanguageAnalyzer, a full-text search component, so search fits; "not a separate project" is no reason for none. mcp: page says nothing, should be unknown.

final.role: Text analysis of the Whoosh pure-Python search library: tokenizers, filters, stemming and per-language analyzers
final.evidence: Classes and functions for turning a piece of text into an indexable stream of "tokens"... LanguageAnalyzer(lang...) Configures a simple analyzer for the given language, with a LowercaseFilter, StopFilter, and StemFilter.

auditoria.nota: Candidate library for language-aware full-text search; Portuguese stemming and project upkeep unconfirmed on the page, and ICUTokenizer in the card does not appear.
